title: AI Companies Prepare For Public Backlash After Potential Catastrophic Incident: Report
hook_text: OpenAI and Anthropic are planning for disaster.
script:
OpenAI and Anthropic are drafting emergency plans for a potential catastrophic AI disaster.
Labs are preparing crisis communications strategies to manage severe public and political backlash.
Executives are worried an autonomous system failure could cause massive infrastructure damage or data leaks.
Lawmakers in Washington are closely monitoring these safety preparations as federal oversight demands grow.
Would you trust OpenAI to handle its own catastrophe?
